description: Example of a SAFE non-streaming OpenAI-compatible chat payload
notes: This payload contains ONLY allowed fields
All messages have roles: 'system', 'user', or 'assistant' only
Content is always a plain string, never an object or array

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Respond in plain text only. Do not use any tools or function calling.

Summarize the following text in 3 bullet points:

[Your text here]

FORBIDDEN_FIELDS_EXAMPLE.note: The following fields must NEVER be included:
FORBIDDEN_FIELDS_EXAMPLE.stream: MUST be false - streaming is disabled
FORBIDDEN_FIELDS_EXAMPLE.tools: NOT ALLOWED - removes tool calling capability
FORBIDDEN_FIELDS_EXAMPLE.response_format: NOT ALLOWED - may cause issues with some providers
FORBIDDEN_FIELDS_EXAMPLE.n: NOT ALLOWED - multiple completions not needed

FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE_FIELDS.note: Messages must NEVER contain these fields:
FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE_FIELDS.tool_call_id: NOT ALLOWED - links to tool calls
